question: Does conservative end-to-end adaptation outperform the protected pretrained source, and does R8 add useful capacity beyond matched direct adaptation?

training.incompletePolicy: stop, record incomplete, do not extend or compare unmatched arms

selection.membership: existing frozen-head cache validation metadata only; never reuse its activations
selection.checkpoint: minimum validation Brier over epochs 0, 1, 2; earliest tie

diagnostic.source: parent validation, excluding all games and effective HalfKP inputs in old cache validation/test
diagnostic.caveat: Pretrained source was selected on parent validation; this is an additional diagnostic, not an untouched final test.
diagnostic.floatAndQuantizedPredictions: per sample, per selected model; recompute quantized transformer for every model
diagnostic.uncertainty: 1000 whole-game paired bootstrap resamples; seed-mean per-position loss differences are primary

direct: each seed >=1 percent relative validation Brier reduction vs source
aggregate float diagnostic 95 percent upper CI <0
residual: each seed >=1 percent relative validation Brier reduction vs matched trained direct
same diagnostic and C++ gates vs matched trained direct
separate inference cost measurement before any strength screen
gates.promotion: no automatic promotion; only a surviving candidate earns a separately preregistered paired strength screen

researchLimits: Brier loss is not chess strength
two seeds do not establish generality
protect verified source and do not alter default evaluator based on this study alone
